author: Datta, Saptarshi and Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Maliha, Sunjida Reza and Liu, Fang and Xu, Jinjia
title: Stimulus-Driven Tuning of Multipathway Emission in 9-Fluorenone Derivatives: Elucidating Charge Transfer Dynamics in Higher Excited Singlet and Triplet States
summary: Combines molecular design, spectroscopy, and excited-state calculations to explain how 9-fluorenone derivatives access fluorescence, charge-transfer emission, phosphorescence, and delayed fluorescence under different molecular and environmental conditions.

author: Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Ghosh, Paulami and Gozem, Samer
title: Electronic Structure Methods for Simulating Flavin's Spectroscopy and Photophysics: Comparison of Multi-reference, TD-DFT, and Single-Reference Wave Function Methods
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B
summary: Benchmarks multireference, TD-DFT, coupled-cluster-related, and other wave-function methods for flavin excited states, clarifying which computational choices are reliable for different spectroscopic and photophysical questions.

author: Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Ouedraogo, Daniel and Orozco-Gonzalez, Yoelvis and Gadda, Giovanni and Gozem, Samer
title: Alternative Strategy for Spectral Tuning of Flavin-Binding Fluorescent Proteins
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B
summary: Uses electrostatic spectral-tuning maps, molecular dynamics, QM/MM calculations, mutagenesis, and spectroscopy to test a rational strategy for shifting the fluorescence of a flavin-binding fluorescent protein.

author: Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Orozco-Gonzalez, Yoelvis and Hastings, Gary and Gozem, Samer
title: The Effect of Hydrogen-Bonding on Flavin's Infrared Absorption Spectrum
journal: Spectrochimica Acta Part A: Molecular and Biomolecular Spectroscopy
summary: Connects hydrogen-bonding environments with changes in flavin infrared absorption and vibrational assignments.

author: Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Orozco-Gonzalez, Yoelvis and Gozem, Samer
title: Electronic Spectra of Flavin in Different Redox and Protonation States: A Computational Perspective on the Effect of the Electrostatic Environment
summary: Computes and interprets flavin spectra across redox and protonation states while mapping how surrounding electrostatics can shift observable transitions.

author: Orozco-Gonzalez, Yoelvis and Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Gozem, Samer
title: Electrostatic Spectral Tuning Maps for Biological Chromophores
journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry B
summary: Introduces three-dimensional maps that visualize how nearby charges tune the excitation energies of biological chromophores.

author: Su, Dan and Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Orozco-Gonzalez, Yoelvis and Gozem, Samer and Gadda, Giovanni
title: Fluorescence Properties of Flavin Semiquinone Radicals in Nitronate Monooxygenase
summary: Combines spectroscopy and electronic-structure calculations to explain unusual fluorescence behavior of a flavin semiquinone radical stabilized in a protein.

author: Zhu, Tianyu and Xu, Shichao and Rahman, Md. Anisur and Dogdibegovic, Emir and Yang, Peng and Pageni, Parasmani and Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Zhou, Xiao-dong and Tang, Chuanbing
title: Cationic Metallo-Polyelectrolytes for Robust Alkaline Anion-Exchange Membranes
summary: Reports cobaltocenium-based polyelectrolytes designed for chemically and mechanically robust alkaline anion-exchange membranes.

author: Pageni, Parasmani and Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Yang, Peng and Tang, Chuanbing
title: Binding of Cobaltocenium-Containing Polyelectrolytes with Anionic Probes
journal: Journal of Inorganic and Organometallic Polymers and Materials
summary: Examines how charge and aromatic interactions influence binding between cobaltocenium-containing polyelectrolytes and anionic molecular or polymeric probes.

author: Yang, Peng and Pageni, Parasmani and Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Zhu, Tianyu and Tang, Chuanbing
title: Metallocene-Containing Homopolymers and Heterobimetallic Block Copolymers via Photoinduced RAFT Polymerization
summary: Demonstrates light-controlled RAFT polymerization of metallocene-containing monomers and the preparation of heterobimetallic block copolymers.

author: Yan, Yi and Pageni, Parasmani and Kabir, Mohammad Pabel and Tang, Chuanbing
title: Metallocenium Chemistry and Its Emerging Impact on Synthetic Macromolecular Chemistry
summary: Reviews metallocenium chemistry and its development as a platform for functional macromolecular and polyelectrolyte materials.

author: Kabir, Md Pabel and Islam, Md Manuarul and Masum, Shah Md and Hossain, Md Mufazzal
title: Adsorption of Remazol Red RR onto Chitosan from Aqueous Solution
journal: Bangladesh Journal of Scientific and Industrial Research
summary: Studies the equilibrium, kinetics, and thermodynamics of dye adsorption onto chitosan from aqueous solution.

author: Kabir, Mohammad Pabel
title: Cobaltocenium Containing Polymers: Complexation With Organic Anion and Initial Assessment for Anion Exchange Membranes
summary: Investigates cobaltocenium-containing polymers, their interactions with organic anions, and their potential use in alkaline anion-exchange membranes.
